notes: Tests now properly distinguish buggy vs fixed code. Buggy workspace fails (exit 101) because the test finds 2 unnecessary Decimal256 Cast nodes in the physical plan for low-precision Decimal128(10,2) + Decimal128(10,2) operations. Fixed workspace passes (exit 0) because the optimization fix in planner.rs avoids unnecessary promotion when boundary value (10) is less than DECIMAL128_MAX_PRECISION (38). The test directly covers the fix.patch changes to native/core/src/execution/datafusion/planner.rs which adds conditional guards for Plus/Minus/Multiply/Modulo operations.
